location.story: The Ox Who Won The Forfeit

approved_translation: Patience and endurance in the face of provocation are ultimately rewarded.
translation_author: Ellen C. Babbitt (retold from traditional sources)
context_summary: Long ago a man owned a very strong Ox. The owner was so proud of his Ox, that he boasted to every man he met about how strong his Ox was. The carts moved on until the last cart stood where the first had been. Then the crowd shouted, and they paid back the forfeit the man had lost, saying: "Your Ox is the strongest Ox we ever saw."
